notices.noGroup: "${file}" does not belong to any mapping group.
notices.noNote: Group "${group}" has note creation turned off — nothing to refresh.
notices.noteBlocked: A different note already occupies that path for "${file}".
notices.auxiliaryMatched: "${file}" matched "${note}" as an auxiliary file and was moved into its folder.
notices.auxiliaryUnmatched: "${file}" has the auxiliary prefix but matched no note — left where it is.
notices.noProperties: "${note}" has no frontmatter properties and the template has no keys either — nothing to compare.
notices.templateMissing: Template "${path}" not found (group ${group}); used the built-in fields.
notices.templaterSkipped: Skipped ${count} Templater block(s) in the template — this plugin does not run them.

unbind.title: Unbind resource
unbind.subtitle: Select the resources to remove from the source of "${note}". This changes only source, never the title, body, or files.

relations.title: Resource relations
relations.empty: Open a note with source links or one of its bound resources to see relations here.
relations.missing: File is missing or the link cannot be resolved

organizer.previewSubtitle: ${changes} move(s) or rename(s); ${managed} owned by mapping groups, ${unmatched} unmatched.
organizer.onlyManaged: ${count} attachment(s) are owned by mapping groups; generic rules skipped them.
organizer.changedSincePreview: Files changed after preview; nothing was applied.
organizer.failed: Organization failed; original paths were restored where possible.

backfill.nothingToChange: There are no pending changes. Resources with a source relation or an existing item folder are skipped.
backfill.previewSubtitle: ${items} resource(s), ${changes} change(s). The tree below shows the result after confirmation; nothing is moved or written before then.

legend.removed: − Red: leaves the old location (the file is not deleted)
legend.added: + Green: new location, note, or property

backfill.complete: Batch complete: ${created} processed, ${skipped} failed or changed since preview.

upgrade.complete: ${group}: updated ${notesUpdated} note(s), added ${propertiesAdded} propert(y/ies). Only filled what was empty — nothing already there was touched.

refresh.title: Refresh metadata
refresh.subtitle: Pick one side per property for "${note}". Unselected rows stay as they are.
refresh.noChanges: The extracted metadata matches the note. Nothing to choose.

sections.mapping: Field mapping (one table for the whole vault)

mapping.desc: Source → property. Empty skips it; source is fixed. Fuzzy matching is supported.

rules.title: Generic attachment rules
rules.desc: Only handles attachments outside mapping-group roots; the first match wins.
rules.catchAllWarning: This rule matches every unmanaged attachment; later rules cannot run.

fields.name: Rule name
fields.sourceFoldersDesc: Comma separated; empty means any. Fuzzy suggestions are available.
fields.extensionsDesc: Values in one field use OR; populated fields use AND. Empty means any.
fields.nameTemplateDesc: The extension is preserved. Supports {{basename}}, {{parent}}, {{note}}, and {{index}}.

kinds.vault: From the vault and the file itself

groups.desc: Each group defines its layout, paths, template, and naming.
groups.empty: No groups yet. Add one to start mapping attachments to notes.

group.name: Group name
group.removeConfirm: Delete the group "${name}"? Notes already created stay where they are.

layout.name: Layout
layout.sidecar: Sidecar (attachment stays put, note is separate)
layout.folder: Folder (resource and note share one item folder)

desc.sidecar: Resources stay put; notes use another folder.
desc.folder: Uses one collection root and handles the selected exact depth.

createNoteFile.name: Create a note for new attachments
createNoteFile.desc: Off: only create the folder and move the resource.

auxiliaryPrefix.name: Auxiliary file prefixes
auxiliaryPrefix.desc: Comma separated. Matches join the same item and source list.

collectionFolder.name: Resource collection folder
collectionFolder.desc: Shared root for the folder layout.

attachmentDepth.name: Attachment depth
attachmentDepth.desc: 0 is the root, 1 is one level down; only that depth is managed.

template.name: Template file
template.desc: Uses template frontmatter; empty uses the built-in template.
template.builtin: Built-in fields: source / title / author / created / updated

mirror.name: Mirror subfolders
mirror.desc: Keep resource folders under the note root.

embed.name: Embed the attachment
embed.desc: Embed the resource at the end of the note.

name.sidecar: Create a note when an attachment is added
name.folder: Fold new attachments into a folder automatically

desc.folder: Off: organize root files only through commands.

syncUpdated.name: Keep the updated property in sync
syncUpdated.desc: Refresh an existing property when the resource changes.

pdfExtraction.name: Read PDF metadata
pdfExtraction.desc: Read title, author, keywords, and more.

backfill.name: Create missing notes
backfill.desc: Preview, then create missing notes in bulk.

upgrade.name: Align all notes to the current template
upgrade.desc: Add only template properties that do not exist yet.

fileNameTitle.name: Title (from file name)
fileNameTitle.desc: Parsed from the name; falls back to the full name.

pdfTitle.name: Title
